native_debug.finding: Pure sigmoid logits alone do not repair MMR. On fixed training examples an evidence candidate at raw rank 2 is sent to final rank 44 by pure-sigmoid relevance with default MMR; raw-logit minmax then actual product MMR retains it at rank 2. This is a mechanism reproduction, not a global preferred configuration.

native_local_debug.finding: The common MMR stage can change the local model order; the fixed cap also prevents correcting evidence outside the first 15. No general local quality loss is inferred from five examples.

experiment.parameter_scope: Best observed configuration in the frozen finite search, not a claim of globally optimal models or all possible training/prompting/architectural changes.

experiment.mmr_search_reason: Before fitting, include both stronger and weaker diversity than default; do not presume the diversity stage is harmful.
